content.title: Graphic Dossier Action | Component Cards to Hero Proof
content.summary: A registered component board alternates with full-body action until the original character, title, and emblem lock together.

quick_start.input_format: One original character and component set persist. + A registered graphic board separates information from action. + Shown components are proven in later motion. + Exactly one peak action is clearly readable. + The ending reunites name, emblem and full silhouette.
quick_start.recommended_input: A marsh guardian proves dossier components through one crescent sweep.
required_anchors: Begin with one compact identity activation before showing the complete subject.
Establish one clearly different graphic reset mode that preserves subject silhouette and proportions.
Raise physical demand in the later action proof while keeping the same defining silhouette and direction cues.
Carry the peak action contour into the final graphic state and hold a complete-subject lockup.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A registered component board alternates with full-body action until the original character, title, and emblem lock together.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 先用原创角色的部件卡建立轮廓和材质，再让全身动作逐项证明设定；每次回到图形板都保持注册，最后以角色、原创称号和徽记收束。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One original character and component set persist.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One original character and component set persist."

invariants.rule: A registered graphic board separates information from action.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "A registered graphic board separates information from action."

invariants.rule: Shown components are proven in later motion.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Shown components are proven in later motion."

invariants.rule: Exactly one peak action is clearly readable.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Exactly one peak action is clearly readable."

invariants.rule: The ending reunites name, emblem and full silhouette.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The ending reunites name, emblem and full silhouette."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
